captions.detailed: A realistic camera zoom lens assembly, featuring a matte black outer barrel, a ribbed zoom ring in the middle, and a ribbed manual focus ring near the front. An inner barrel extends outward from the front of the main barrel, housing a blue-tinted glass lens element. The rear of the outer barrel terminates in a metallic bayonet mount plate. The zoom ring and focus ring rotate on revolute joints, while the inner barrel extends on a prismatic joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a standard camera zoom lens. It should feature a main matte black outer barrel with a metallic rear bayonet mount, a ribbed zoom ring that rotates on a revolute joint, an inner barrel that extends forward on a prismatic joint, and a ribbed manual focus ring near the front that rotates on a second revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the lens using concentric cylinders of varying radii and heights. Create the main outer barrel, the inner extending barrel, and the front focus ring using standard cylinder primitives. Add ribbed textures to the zoom and focus rings by subtracting or patterning small radial cuts or utilizing concentric cylinder segments. Define four main parts (outer barrel, zoom ring, focus ring, and inner barrel) and connect them using two revolute joints for the rings and one prismatic joint for the telescoping inner barrel.
